title: Team Setup & Research
description: Finalise team structure, review rules, research, and estimate budget.

title: Architecture Down-select
description: Select the vehicle architecture and subsystem concept. Initial packaging with justification and calculations.

title: Rules Review & Concept Freeze
description: Review FSUK 2027 rules, finalise the concept, freeze major decisions and subsystem targets. Release master CAD and perform laptime simulations.

title: DCS & Funding Internal Approval
description: Complete the DCS with the HLPP, review funding applications, and hold internal reviews ahead of registration.

title: FSUK Registration
description: Submit the DCS and complete team registration.

title: Safety-Critical Release & SES/ESA/ESO
description: Release the safety-critical design, complete the SES and ESA/ESO, and submit by the official deadlines.

title: ESF Submission Gate
description: Complete the electrical design and validation, and submit the ESF before the official deadline.

title: Integrated Vehicle & First Drive
description: Complete subsystem manufacturing, integrate the vehicle, conduct bench testing, and achieve the first drive.

title: EDR, DSS & IAD Submission Gate
description: Finalise and submit the EDR, DSS and IAD. Conduct scrutineering and all vehicle dynamic tests. Prepare spares.

title: Development & Reliability Review
description: Complete the first endurance-equivalent test, conduct reliability validation, and close all major issues. Prepare the vehicle for shipment.

title: Competition Readiness Gate
description: Complete full mock scrutineering, finalise presentations, and arrange spares, logistics and supporting documents for competition.
